validity.recommendation: Treat as a GEM-only synthetic segment; obtain the original Aramco/source pipeline table before keeping as a standalone row. No independent confirmation of this discrete km0-km56 entity exists.
validity.researcher_notes: P1910 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56' is a machine-generated kilometer-post label, not a name used by any independent source. UBTG-1 decodes to 'Uthmaniyah-Berri Trunk Gas Line 1', and the broader trunkline corridor connecting the Uthmaniyah, Berri and Hawiyah gas plants IS real (Master Gas System; confirmed by Fluor and Aramco corporate material). BUT no independent source names a discrete 'km0-to-km56' segment, confirms it as a separate pipeline, or states its specs. The gem.wiki page's ONLY citations are OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (2012, 2017) — verified those PDFs do NOT contain pipeline-segment tables with km posts/diameters (url_verifier: the 2017 ASB returns 200 but does NOT contain 'UBTG' or 'pipeline' in this sense; it is a national statistics bulletin). Every web search hit for this name circles back to gem.wiki. This is the classic signature of a GEM-only entity derived from a tabular dump (likely a proprietary Aramco GIS/pipeline registry) split into km-post rows. Existence of the physical corridor is plausible; existence of THIS discrete catalogued entity is unconfirmed by any independent origin.

validity.recommendation: Reconcile P1910 / P1911 / P1912 as one physical right-of-way. P1910 (48 in) and P1911 (40 in) almost certainly describe parallel/looped pipes on the SAME km0->km56 corridor; consider merging or recording as OtherEnglishNames / loop lines rather than three independent pipelines.
validity.researcher_notes: P1910 (48 in), P1911 'UBTG-1-km0-UBTG-1-km56 2' (40 in) and P1912 'Hawiyah-UBTG-1-km0' (56 in) are all length=56.00 km, RouteAccuracy='no route', blank endpoints, status=operating, owner=Saudi Aramco. P1910 and P1911 share the identical name stem and km0->km56 span differing only in diameter and a trailing '2' — textbook parallel/loop lines double-counted as separate rows. P1912 is the immediately upstream feeder into km0 of the same corridor. Without geometry or independent endpoint confirmation these read as one physical trunkline corridor split into segment/loop rows from a tabular source. Flagging P1911 (and relatedly P1912) as the duplicate-corridor counterparts of P1910.

validity.recommendation: Do not treat 56 km / 48 in as corroborated. Find the originating Aramco pipeline table; no independent source agrees with these numbers.
validity.researcher_notes: Length=56.00 km and Diameter=48 in could not be independently corroborated by any non-GEM source. Aramco/Fluor/MEED material about the Uthmaniyah-Berri-Hawiyah corridor mentions various diameters (48 in inlet/outlet lines at Hawiyah NGL, 56 in rich-gas lines) but NONE ties a 48-inch, 56-km figure to this specific km0-km56 segment. The 56 km value is suspect because P1910, P1911 and P1912 all carry the identical 56 km length, consistent with a single corridor length copied across rows rather than three independently measured pipes. Status=operating, Fuel=Gas and Owner=Saudi Aramco are consistent with the real Master Gas System but are inherited generics, not segment-specific confirmations. No spec field can be raised above 'low'.

summary: P1910 is a GEM-only synthetic km-post segment of the real UBTG-1 (Uthmaniyah-Berri) trunkline; flagged existence + duplicate (P1911/P1912 = same km0-km56 corridor/loop) + spec (56 km/48 in uncorroborated). Only the broad corridor is independently confirmed (Fluor); the discrete entity and its specs are not. No reliable fills available.
